integrity_note: All-dimensions statements follow from explicit algebra and Fourier diagonalization; finite numerical verifications are corroborative. The general Gabor-POVM spectral formula is prior art; only the sharp parameter-and-step design is advanced as new.
scientific_limitations: Only full cyclic Gabor projector orbits with two taps at non-antipodal separation and linear reconstruction on the observable three-diagonal matrix band; not universal phase retrieval or complete Hermitian tomography.
title: Sharp conditioning of two-tap cyclic Gabor operator bands
